question: What does the already-implemented ttnn diffusion trace (Boltz.__init__(diffusion_trace=True) -> DiffusionModule.forward_traced) remove from the Boltz-2 fold, and does it come out of the clock-immune term or the clock-scaled work?
design: diffusion_trace False and True INTERLEAVED inside one process and one device context, at two pinned clocks. The device is opened with a 1 GiB trace region in BOTH arms, so the only thing that varies between the two labels of a pair is which python callable the sampler invokes per step. Reserving the region is therefore not part of the measured delta; it is held constant and priced separately.

lever.toggled: as an attribute on the live model between labels; production source is untouched and the harness asserts an empty production diff against source_base

clock.order: inside a clock block, arms alternate U,T on even reps and T,U on odd reps, so neither arm sits systematically early or late
clock.mechanism: ARC FORCE_AICLK (0x33) through tt-kmd's SMC message queue, re-sent and re-verified before EVERY label, released in the finally block
clock.settle: the requested MHz must appear in sysfs and stay there for 200 ms before the timer starts, within a 5 s timeout
clock.1000_is_an_arm: scripts/aiclk_watch.sh flags a busy chip under 1200 MHz as CLAMPED-UNDER-LOAD. The 1000 MHz block trips that guard on purpose: it is requested, settled and sampled during every fold, and its board power is recorded. A pinned 1000 MHz fold is a measurement; an unrequested one is an artifact.

work_witness.why: a trace lever is only this lever if it runs the identical program sequence. Fewer steps would be a cheat, not a speedup.
work_witness.how: both the traced and the untraced score-model entry points are wrapped by an identical counting shim, installed for both arms, so the instrument cost is the same on both sides. Every fold must show exactly sampling_steps calls down its own arm's path and zero down the other.
work_witness.second_witness: the traced path documents itself as bit-identical to the untraced forward. CIF SHA256 equality between arms tests that claim for free.

host_cpu_witness.foreign: any process outside the run session (own=false)

quiet.co_tenancy: STOP rather than measure anyway; never signal a holder

accuracy.metric: maximum independently superposed domain all-atom float64 Kabsch RMSD, split after residue 298; also report whole-chain all-atom
accuracy.digest_first: the code claims bit-identical output by construction, so the primary parity evidence is CIF SHA256 equality between arms. A digest change is NOT automatically a failure, but an unexplained one is: fall back to the Angstrom bar at that size, quoted with its own seed floor.
accuracy.conventions: the 512 bar and its 1.84 A user seed floor and the 298 bar with its own 0.741-0.847 A archived upstream seed pairs are each used only at their own size

kill: wrong opened node, containment change or boot change
foreign device holder or quiet/lock timeout
clock read error, a clock other than that fold's own target, or a coverage gap
FORCE_AICLK refused, or a requested clock that did not settle before the timer started
a fold whose step counters do not show exactly sampling_steps calls down its own arm and zero down the other
structural deviation between arms over the size bar
foreign host CPU process at or above 20% of a core during an accepted fold
refutation: a median gain at 512 aa inside the 0.055 s A/A floor c10-bare-baseline recorded: the lever is retired in one pass
any failure to capture the trace, or a capture that raises: VERDICT STOP with the exact failure point
a traced arm that does not run 200 steps: this is not this lever
bare: Production wheel, no Tracy/graph/observer/module timers/sum profiling, no hoist, no --fast, no MSA truncation, no tensor parallelism, no bfp8, no kernel change, no reduction of steps or recycles. Synchronize before the monotonic start and after predict_one including CIF writing: c10-bare-baseline's timer boundary, unchanged.
unmeasured: No device-cycle census and no per-op attribution. The split of the gain into clock-immune and clock-scaled seconds comes from two pinned clocks only. The 1 GiB region's effect on sizes larger than 512 aa is a separate check and is not part of the A/B.
